content: Execute Program: short lessons interleave prose with executable, checked problems throughout (every prompt runnable, not blocked at the end). Lessons gate on prerequisites (won't unlock until prior lessons' reviews are passing). Daily cap on new lessons per course prevents bingeing a whole course in one sitting. Completed lesson items enter a fixed-schedule spaced-repetition review queue (author describes it as cruder than Anki's adaptive model) that roughly retires an item after the 4th correct repetition, around day 64. Wrong answers do not penalize unless the learner gives up; review holds place until answered correctly. Review load starts ~10 min/day and decays toward zero as intervals grow.
